issues.description: Amazon Linux/Rocky prep no longer installs git via yum but assumes dnf works on legacy AMIs
issues.detail: test-install-scripts.yml replaces `yum install --assumeyes git` with `dnf update -y` plus `dnf search python3.12` and `dnf install`. Older Amazon Linux 2 images do not ship dnf; this will break those jobs. Also `dnf search` is non-essential noise that should not gate the install step. Confirm the runner image actually has dnf or pin to a known-good image.

issues.description: install.sh error message still allows Python 3.7-3.9 through the version gate
issues.detail: The bound check `PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7` was not updated to 10, but the printed error says ">= 3.10". A user with python3.9 installed will pass the numeric check yet see a confusing message, or the script will proceed where it should now abort. The condition should be `-lt 10` to match the stated requirement.

issues.description: Dead `default_raise` comment and helper referencing dropped <3.10 compatibility
issues.detail: wallet_request_types.py still defines `default_raise` with the comment "This should be impossible to hit and is just for < 3.10 compatibility" and many fields use `field(default_factory=default_raise)`. With kw_only now unconditional, this scaffolding is no longer needed and the comment is misleading. Either remove default_raise entirely (use plain required kw-only fields) or update the rationale.

issues.description: Ruff TODO ignores UP045/UP007/UP035 defeat a stated goal of the PR
issues.detail: ruff.toml adds blanket ignores for the very Union/Optional rewrite rules the PR description highlights as upcoming. Without an owner or follow-up issue link this TODO will rot. Either link a tracking issue in the comment or apply the rewrites in this PR rather than landing a permanent escape hatch.

issues.description: Stray `dnf search python3.12` left in install steps
issues.detail: The added `dnf search python3.12` lines in Amazon/Rocky prep produce no installation effect and add noise (and a non-zero exit if metadata is unreachable in a slim sandbox). Drop them or move to a separate diagnostic step.

issues.description: README still pins MINIMUM=3.10 in Ubuntu prep but no fallback for newer images
issues.detail: test-install-scripts.yml sets `MINIMUM=3.10` and relies on `apt-get satisfy`. On Ubuntu 24.04 the default python3 is 3.12 which satisfies; fine. But the fallback `python${MINIMUM}-venv` will fail on noble where python3.10 is not in the default repos. Verify the matrix images or add a PPA step.

review.summary: This PR cleanly removes Python 3.9 support across CI, install scripts, and dataclass scaffolding, and the wallet_request_types simplification is a clear win. The main concerns are CI install steps that swap yum for dnf without verifying image support and add a stray `dnf search`, an install.sh version gate that wasn't updated to match the new 3.10 floor, and a ruff.toml that ignores UP007/UP035/UP045 - the very modernization the PR description points toward. Dead `default_raise` scaffolding and its <3.10 comments should also be cleaned up or explicitly retained with a new rationale.
